instruction: The precondition FreeCAD file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that project in FreeCAD, run the macro, choose the material "Metal Silver (Ag),10.5,10.0,adapt Price", save the density, weight, volume, and related material information to a spreadsheet inside the project using tabulation as the separator, name the spreadsheet Body_Spreadsheet, and save the project to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
